plugin.typecho-plugin-queue.name: Queue
plugin.typecho-plugin-queue.description: Background task transport and queue monitoring for Cloudflare Workers. Disabling stops new tasks; pending messages retry and are discarded at the retry limit.
plugin.typecho-plugin-queue.config.queue: Shown on the admin Queue page and used for drift warnings. Keep it aligned with the Wrangler producer/consumer queue name.
plugin.typecho-plugin-queue.config.accou: Optional. Enables account-level queue configuration and metrics.
plugin.typecho-plugin-queue.config.apiTo: Optional. Use a token with only the Queues Read permission. Stored in the site database.
